people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

translations.web: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”
translations.bsb: So now, my lord the king, do not take to heart the report that all the sons of the king are dead. Only Amnon is dead.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
translations.asv: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead; for Amnon only is dead.
